schemaNote: PROPOSED manifest format. The LQAI Spire has no published cabinet spec as of 2026-07-09; this file describes the game so the venue maintainer can wire it to whatever the cabinets expect. See docs/LQAI_PLUGIN_SPEC.md.
name: Depo Doom
author: Joel A. Kaufmann
description: Deposition-training arcade game. Choose your litigator; each round a coin flip decides your side — take the deposition (foundation, exhibits, impeachment) or defend it (objection calls, privilege instructions, restraint). Twelve fictional witnesses. Training simulation, not legal advice.

runtime.iframeSandbox: allow-scripts (allow-same-origin only needed for persistent hi-scores)

outbound.payload: { xp, witnessId, rank, litigator, won, mode: 'take'|'defend' }

inbound.effect: optional; may carry { playerName } to display on the title screen
